# Lyorune

> Lyorune is a free healing frames addon (raid frames with click casting) for World of Warcraft: Forever, the official Blizzard game (interface 16001). Made by BellaDroode. Available in French and English. Current version: {{version}}.

Lyorune shows the whole group or raid as frames and casts the healer's spells with one click on a player's frame. It is designed to be simple, light in combat (events per unit, no permanent loop) and pleasant to look at. It suits every healer class on WoW Forever: priest, druid, paladin and shaman. It never changes the game's frames or other addons' frames, so it runs alongside ElvUI, Clique and other interface addons. No dependencies.

Main features:
- Click casting: every mouse button, alone or with Shift, Ctrl, Alt, casts a chosen spell on a player's frame, at the rank you choose; a trinket can go with the spell; statistics show how often each click is used.
- Hover keys: a keyboard key, extra mouse button or wheel casts a spell on the hovered frame.
- Everything at a glance: health, incoming heals, shields, heal absorbs, mana, other healers' low mana and their drink, your external spells (Power Infusion, Innervate), Weakened Soul and Forbearance, heals over time and debuffs (drawn by the game, visible in combat), boss private auras, players' big defensives, crowd control, healthy players faded (optional), threat, range in three levels, global cooldown, casting bar or ring.
- Dispels: the frame lights up for magic, curse, disease or poison, up to 3 debuffs to dispel per frame.
- Mana: a soft blue screen edge when your mana runs low, and a five second rule line on your frame.
- Resurrection on the same click on a dead player.
- Healer and buff assignments (/lyorune assign): a gold line marks the players you look after; the leader sends the assignments to every healer who has Lyorune, before the fight.
- Missing buffs out of combat, in a thin strip under the frames; your own buffs to cast again in grey on each frame.
- Game key bindings (AddOns section): open the options, show or hide the frames, cast the next missing buff, test mode.
- Macros written once, put on a click or dragged onto an action bar.
- Low mana announcement that still works when WoW Forever hides mana from addons.
- Five themes, high contrast, four frame shapes, every element placed and resized per character, sorting by group or role, separate tank and pet frames, pinned players.
- Profiles per group size, battleground and specialization, applied automatically; partial copy; sharing by code or in game; four ready-made profiles.
- Test mode with a fake group of 5 to 40 players; built-in one-minute tutorial.
- Options window in twelve chapters: a preview cell shows every setting live, a golden rune marks changed settings (one click resets them), and a search finds any setting.
- Friends of Lyorune: healer's notebook with today's summary, healers' channel in French and in English.

Keywords: World of Warcraft, World of Warcraft: Forever, WoW Forever, WoW addon, MMORPG, healing frames, raid frames, party frames, click casting, healer addon, dungeon, raid, PvP, battleground, arena.

Installation: with the CurseForge or Wago app (updates included), or download the archive, unzip it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`, start the game. Main command: `/lyorune`.

License: all rights reserved, free to use and share unchanged. Four official sources: CurseForge, Wago, WoWInterface, GitHub Releases.

## En français

Lyorune est un addon gratuit de cadres de soin pour World of Warcraft: Forever : soin d'un clic, touches au survol, dissipation, soins en route, portée, buffs manquants, annonce de mana faible même quand la mana est cachée, profils, thèmes et partage. Pour le prêtre, le druide, le paladin et le chaman. Auteur : BellaDroode.
